claims.violated_requirement: The Gray code to binary conversion incorrectly uses gray_wire[2] instead of gray_wire[3] for the MSB, causing incorrect binary values and subsequent Gray code outputs. This will be detected when the counter reaches states where gray_wire[3] and gray_wire[2] differ.
claims.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray code to binary conversion where each bit depends on the previous bits through XOR operations.

claims.violated_requirement: The XOR operation in Gray code to binary conversion is replaced with AND, causing incorrect binary values when both bits are 1. This will be detected when the counter reaches states where both gray_wire[2] and bin_out[3] are 1.
claims.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations between bits.

claims.violated_requirement: The XOR operation in Gray code to binary conversion is replaced with OR, causing incorrect binary values when either bit is 1. This will be detected when the counter reaches states where gray_wire[1] and bin_out[2] differ.
claims.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations between bits.

claims.violated_requirement: The XOR operation in Gray code to binary conversion is replaced with OR, causing incorrect binary values when either bit is 1. This will be detected when the counter reaches states where gray_wire[0] and bin_out[1] differ.
claims.spec_basis: The specification requires correct Gray code to binary conversion using XOR operations between bits.
